title: [SPR2-001] Flyway migrations for tenant/account/bank/transaction (reversible + indexes)
body:
Objective: persist core schema.

DoD:
- Create Flyway scripts for tables: tenant, user(tenant-scoped), bank, account, transaction, idempotency_keys.
- Reversible where feasible; baseline version tagged.
- Critical indexes: (tenant_id, bank_id, booking_date), (tenant_id, account_id, booking_date), unique (tenant_id, source_id) for transactions, unique (route, key) for idempotency.

Acceptance:
- `mvn -q -DskipTests exec:java` (or app startup) applies migrations locally.
- Testcontainers integration confirms schema present.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR2-002] Implement JPA repositories + Testcontainers (PostgreSQL)
body:
Objective: wire persistence layer with tests.

DoD:
- Repositories for tenant, user, bank, account, transaction, idempotency keys.
- Testcontainers PG integration tests for basic CRUD and constraints.

Acceptance:
- CI runs integration tests against Testcontainers and they pass.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR2-003] Persistent Idempotency-Key store & HTTP filter
body:
Objective: move idempotency from in-memory to DB.

DoD:
- Table `idempotency_keys(route, key, response_hash, created_at)` with unique(route, key).
- Spring filter/aspect storing key before handler; on duplicate, return stored response.
- Update ADR-004 with persistence details.

Acceptance:
- Duplicate POST with same `Idempotency-Key` returns 200 and identical body.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-004] Excel ingestion MVP with bank association and sourceId dedupe
body:
Objective: import transactions from .xlsx.

DoD:
- Read .xlsx; minimal header mapping (manual selection for now).
- Validate rows; persist transactions with (tenant_id, account_id, bank_id, source_id, amount, currency, booking_date, description).
- Idempotent import via unique (tenant_id, source_id).
- Return counts: inserted/ignored/failed.

Acceptance:
- Sample file of 500+ rows imports successfully; re-import reports ignored duplicates.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR2-005] Sample datasets & deterministic seeds for ingestion tests
body:
Objective: have stable fixtures.

DoD:
- Place 2–3 sample Excel files under `test-resources/ingestion/` (different banks).
- Seed factory methods for tenants/accounts/banks.

Acceptance:
- Integration tests reference fixtures; no network dependency.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR2-006] Update OpenAPI v1 (+CHANGELOG) to include bankId and transaction shapes
body:
Objective: keep contracts in sync with persistence.

DoD:
- Update `docs/contracts/openapi/v1/openapi.yaml` for /v1/transactions with `bankId`, `sourceId`, and full schemas.
- Ensure Problem Details and `Idempotency-Key` documented.
- Update contract CHANGELOG.

Acceptance:
- Spec validates; contract tests updated and pass.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-007] FX provider SPI + stub implementation with day-rate cache
body:
Objective: enable historical conversions.

DoD:
- SPI: `getRate(LocalDate, from, to)`; cache by (date, pair).
- Stub provider with deterministic rates for tests.
- Config flag to select provider.

Acceptance:
- Unit tests show deterministic conversion for USD↔EUR↔COP on given dates.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-008] Balance API with EUR & COP equivalents (historical FX)
body:
Objective: expose balances in native currency plus EUR and COP.

DoD:
- Endpoint `GET /v1/accounts/{id}/balance?at=YYYY-MM-DD` (optional `at`, defaults to now).
- Returns: native balance, EUR-equivalent, COP-equivalent; includes FX source and date used.

Acceptance:
- For a USD account with 100 USD on 2025-01-01, response includes converted EUR and COP using stub rates.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR2-009] End-to-end integration test: ingest → query balances (EUR/COP)
body:
Objective: prove the full flow.

DoD:
- Testcontainers: start PG; import sample Excel; call Balance API.
- Assert native and converted balances match expectations.

Acceptance:
- Test passes in CI; logs show no SQL constraint violations.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-010] Migration tests: forward/backward compatibility
body:
Objective: ensure safe schema evolution.

DoD:
- Tests applying up migrations, then rolling back one step where feasible.
- Verify data survives restarts.

Acceptance:
- CI job passes on clean DB and on pre-seeded DB.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-011] ADR-006: Critical DB indexes for query patterns
body:
Objective: document indexing strategy.

DoD:
- New ADR describing chosen indexes and rationale (workload, filters, ordering).
- Link to `EXPLAIN` examples from integration tests.

Acceptance:
- ADR committed; referenced from Scope CHANGELOG if changes are impactful.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR2-012] Observability counters for ingestion (inserted/ignored/failed) + JSON logs
body:
Objective: baseline metrics and logs.

DoD:
- Counters for ingestion outcomes exposed via Prometheus.
- Structured JSON logs include correlationId/tenantId.

Acceptance:
- Local `/metrics` shows counters after an import; logs include correlation id.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-013] DB roles and least-privilege connection for app
body:
Objective: security baseline for data layer.

DoD:
- Create DB role with minimum privileges required by the app; separate migration user vs app user.
- Compose/env wired to use app role.

Acceptance:
- App boots and integration tests pass using the limited role.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-014] Docs update: Scope CHANGELOG + OpenAPI CHANGELOG + run/debug guide for ingestion
body:
Objective: keep docs current.

DoD:
- Update `docs/governance/scope-CHANGELOG.md` for Sprint 2 features.
- Update `docs/contracts/openapi/v1/CHANGELOG.md` with new/changed fields.
- Add a short run/debug guide for Excel ingestion to README or docs.

Acceptance:
- MkDocs site shows updated pages; links work.

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR2-015] Deploy API & Web to Render (Free) + managed Postgres
body:
Objective: live demo environment.

DoD:
- Connect repo to Render; enable auto-deploy from main.
- API: Docker deploy; health check green.
- Web: Next.js SSR service; env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL set.
- Managed Postgres (Free) linked; DB schema applied on boot.

Acceptance:
- Public URLs respond; /health is 200; basic flow works end-to-end.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR2-016] Seed & export scripts for Render Postgres (Free)
body:
Objective: mitigate 30-day DB expiry.

DoD:
- Seed runner (Java or SQL) to bootstrap minimal data.
- Export script (pg_dump) and docs to restore quickly.
- Nightly GitHub Action (cron) to build seed artifact (no secret dumps).

Acceptance:
- Seed/import works locally and in Render DB.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR2-017] Cold-start monitoring & demo keep-alive window
body:
Objective: visibility and optional mitigation of idle spin-down.

DoD:
- Metric: 'first-hit after idle P95' in logs/metrics.
- Optional keep-alive during scheduled demo windows (e.g., GitHub Action workflow curl to /health every 10m, disabled by default).
- Document ethical/ToS considerations; do not run 24/7 keep-alive.

Acceptance:
- Dashboard panel shows first-hit latency distribution.

Estimate: 1 pt
